items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: I stayed on with Benny Carter and Eddie Beall, at the same place.

ctx.x: Yeah. And we stayed there quite a while. And then when they left, I stayed on with Benny Carter and Eddie Beall, at the same place. And I went to work one night and they had a padlock on the door. My bass is in there and I had to get the bus home. Benny lived in Hollywood and Eddie Beall lived in Hollywood, so I had to get the bus home. And I got off the bus there at Adams and Western. I was crossing the street and as I got halfway across, here comes a truck down the hill, heading east, his brakes failed, and he…

torn off me." It wasn't torn off me, but oil was ground in it so it wasn't any use. It was a light colored suit, you know, sort of an egg shell color. And they kept sending him around weekly, until I'd hired a lawyer. Now the lawyer said he would get something like 30-percent and I would get 70 percent if it's settled in court. Court battles you can fight forever, you know. And the trucking firm, too, if they had money to fight it with. So finally the adjuster came by and said, "Well, how would you like to settle…
